patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image transitions into a deep black background for subsequent content sections, creating high contrast and a sense of luxury.
A stark black and white base palette is consistently accented with a vibrant, bold red for calls to action and key brand elements.
Hero and section titles use a very wide, thin, uppercase sans-serif font for a sophisticated and modern display effect.
The hero image features a subtle parallax effect where the background moves at a different speed than the foreground watch as the user scrolls.
The primary navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay to a solid white background with black text and icons upon scrolling past the hero section.
Content sections below the hero are presented on a solid black background, often featuring full-width imagery or grid layouts with minimal padding, maintaining a premium feel.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a layered approach with a background image and a foreground product image, both moving at slightly different rates to create a subtle parallax scroll effect. Text elements are positioned absolutely over this composition.

The main navigation bar employs a scroll-triggered state change: initially transparent with light text, it transitions to a solid white background with dark text and icons once the user scrolls past a certain point, likely using a CSS class toggle.

Content sections appear to reveal with a fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience. This could be achieved using CSS keyframes or a JavaScript library like Lottie for more complex animations, triggered by scroll events.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, thin, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide a sophisticated display, complemented by smaller, regular-weight uppercase labels and standard body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant throughout the design, with only very subtle rounding applied to interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero and between major content blocks, creating a sense of spaciousness; content grids and footer sections are more balanced in density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dramatic, full-bleed hero with subtle parallax, immediately transitioning to a deep black background for all subsequent content, creates a powerful, high-contrast, and luxurious brand experience. This bold shift in background color and density is highly impactful.
